name: 60656 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60656 (Chicago) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60656 (Chicago) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
